blurb: State Street Axe Club offers axe throwing in a high-energy, safe setting with expert coaching in downtown Santa Barbara. They also feature a Rage Room experience where guests smash a variety of items using bats, crowbars, hammers, and more (closed shoes required, safety gear provided). Offerings are suitable for adults and kids ages 10 and up, with group, birthday, and corporate event options. Coaching and safety training are included for all participants.
